# v3.40.0

Covers everything since **v3.39.0**.

This release is about keeping the server itself up to date. Updates now upgrade **Node.js** when it falls below a version carrying the latest security fixes, new installs turn on the operating system's **automatic security updates**, and **Admin › Updates** shows the state of both. It also fixes **exports to Box**, which were failing. There are no database changes in this release.

## New — keeping the server patched

- **Node.js is upgraded during updates when it needs to be.** Each release now carries the lowest Node.js version with the security fixes it relies on. If your server runs an older release of the same Node.js line, the update upgrades Node.js before rebuilding the app, then restarts on it. It only upgrades a Node.js installed from the system's package manager, never moves to a new major line, and never blocks an update if the upgrade cannot happen.
- **Admin › Updates shows the Node.js version the server is running**, with an amber notice when it is below the recommended version or on a line that is no longer supported.
- **New installs turn on automatic operating-system security updates.** The installer now asks whether to switch on the system's own automatic security updates (unattended-upgrades) and does so by default. These cover everything the app's own updates do not, such as PostgreSQL, OpenSSL and the system's certificates. A deliberate "off" in your existing configuration is respected, and existing servers are not changed by this update.
- **Admin › Updates shows whether automatic OS security updates are on**, with an amber notice explaining what is off and how to turn it on.

## Fixed

- **Exports to Box failed every time.** Scheduled and on-demand exports to a Box folder stopped working after a library upgrade. They now upload again; if the connection to Box has expired, the export now says it needs reconnecting.
- The update log no longer shows a misleading error line from a successful build.

## Security and maintenance

- Several third-party libraries have been updated to versions with security fixes, including the email library used for scheduled exports and the database client.
- The project now checks its libraries for published security advisories on every change and weekly, including the spreadsheet library, which is downloaded directly from its publisher and was not covered before.

## For administrators

- **Updating is recommended.** No action is needed beyond the normal update.
- If automatic updates are switched off on your server, Node.js will not be upgraded for you. Admin › Updates will show a notice if it is below the recommended version.
- To turn on automatic OS security updates on an existing server, follow the steps in the notice on Admin › Updates, or see the "OS security updates" section of the README.

This is a minor release (`3.39.0` → `3.40.0`) because it adds features.
